name: varg-ad-variants
description: Turns one winning video ad into 20 ad variants that Meta's Andromeda and TikTok treat as different creatives: tag the winner with varg video_analyze, plan two layers (about 7 new concepts that each change message, visual execution or format, plus about 13 single-variable iterations, mostly new hooks), generate the new openers and concepts on varg (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs), swap hooks onto the winner with a tested FFmpeg script (word-boundary cut, normalised parts, 20 ms fade, manifest), re-caption every variant, and export names and a test plan. Use when a seller asks for ad variations, more creatives, hook variants, "scale my winning ad", "make 20 versions of this ad", creative testing volume for Meta or TikTok, or new hooks for an ad that is fatiguing. Not for the testing strategy alone (ad-creative-testing), finding winners from competitors (varg-ad-library-remix), or a brand-new single ad.
